content:
tom: Starting transport window at 03:30 UTC for private/vpc onprem bundle. Primary goal: push signed installer + multi-arch images to escort lanes. Watch bandwidth caps.

anya: Noted. I've uploaded the offline bundle to staging S3 path and ran checksum verification. One small mismatch on a debug map file. Rebuilding with stripped dt performed.

kevin: Heads up: mirror proxies have a 200Mbps burst cap per lane. We need to stagger fetches or we'll get TCP stalls. Recommend 2s inter-seed delay.

ops-amy: Policy: no single lane should exceed 75% of allocated bandwidth for >10s during rollout. Ops will throttle if exceeded.

tom: Agreed. Plan: canary 2 seeds per lane (3 lanes) with 90s spacing between seed starts. Observe 20m. If any lane exceeds error threshold -> rollback.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] created release ref private-installer@v2024.04.10 pinned -> sha256:beef...1234. S3: s3://redwood-offline/releases/1723456789/. cosign: key=installer-prod-01

anya: Verified cosign signature locally. Also uploaded cosign.pub to mirrors under keys/.

packager-bot: [packager-bot] ran preflight: gzip integrity OK, manifest schema v2 OK, labels: {arch:amd64,arm64}.

kevin: During a dry-run I saw escort runner start pulls in lockstep. I'll flip the runner to jitter=1-4s. Patching now.

ops-amy: Adding monitoring rule: alert if failed pulls >2 across any lane within 5m. Will also watch egress.

tom: Quick rollback commands in case of issues:
```
deploy-bot rollback --target private-installer --pin v2024.03.88
# quick stop of seeding
opsctl escort stop-seed --labels "release=canary"
```

anya: Canary seeds kicked off: lanes=[north,south,central], seeds_per_lane=2, spacing=90s, start_ts=1723456789

packager-bot: [packager-bot] canary update (5m): north OK, south partial (1/2 seeds failed verify), central OK. Fail reason: signature verification failed on one node (local cosign cache old).

kevin: That sounds like a stale cosign.pub on that mirror. Pushing updated pubkey; will force cache invalidation.

ops-amy: Applying cache invalidation. If the node still fails, we'll evict and re-seed.

packager-bot: (10m) south recovered after cache refresh. All seeds passed verification. Observing bandwidth: north 60% burst, central 45%, south 70%.

kevin: Good. Proceed to rolling batches: batches of 4 nodes every 15m, inter-batch pause 5m for metrics.

anya: Small snag: one telemetry collector reported mismatched artifact length for arm64 image on mirror-02. I'm re-checking object multipart upload completeness.

tom: Hold the next batch. If it's just a multipart remnant, we can re-invalidate and re-upload. If checksums differ, rollback.

packager-bot: [packager-bot] integrity check: arm64 image re-uploaded; new sha256:1a2b...c3d4. Cosign re-signed. re-pinned?

deploy-bot: [deploybot] attempt to re-pin to new hash blocked: current release ref locked by release-controller until first full batch completes. Manual override required.

tom: Manual override granted. deploy-bot, please update pin to sha256:1a2b...c3d4 and note change in release notes.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] updated pin: private-installer@v2024.04.10 -> sha256:1a2b...c3d4. Change logged: reason=arm64 multipart reupload.

ops-amy: Rolling batches resumed. Watching for >2 verify failures.

packager-bot: (end observation) Rolling complete. No post-rollout evictions. Artifact retention TTL set to 90d for this release. KMS audit entry created.

kevin: Post-release action item: add mirror pubkey propagation step to packaging pipeline and auto-invalidate cosign cache on first seed.

anya: I'll file the bug and include logs. Also creating a short how-to for customers on verifying offline bundles locally.

tom: Nice work. Closing thread unless someone has objections.

ops-amy: One last note: tagging release for canary support window and adding ops runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/offline-delivery

kevin: thumbs up.
